title: The Secret Life of the Inhibitor of Virus Replication.
authors: Palukaitis, Peter; Akbarimotlagh, Masoud; Baek, Eseul; Yoon, Ju-Yeon
one_liner_zh: 该文研究病毒复制抑制蛋白IVR与APC7的结构关系，涉及转录因子结合位点预测但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The inhibitor of virus replication (IVR) is an inducible protein that is not virus-target-specific and can be induced by several viruses. The GenBank was interrogated for sequences closely related to the tobacco IVR. Various RNA fragments from tobacco, tomato, and potato and their genomic DNA contained IVR-like sequences. However, IVRs were part of larger proteins encoded by these genomic DNA sequences, which were identified in Arabidopsis as being related to the cyclosome protein designated anaphase-promoting complex 7 (APC7). Sequence analysis of the putative APC7s of nine plant species showed proteins of 558-561 amino acids highly conserved in sequence containing at least six protein-binding elements of 34 amino acids called tetratricopeptide repeats (TPRs), which form helix-turn-helix structures. The structures of Arabidopsis APC7 and the tobacco IVR proteins were modeled using the AlphaFold program and superimposed, showing that IVR had the same structure as the C-terminal 34% of APC7, indicating that IVR was a product of the APC7 gene. Based on the presence of various transcription factor binding sites in the APC7 sequences upstream of the IVR coding sequences, we propose that IVR could be expressed by these APC7 gene sequences involving the transcription factor SHE1.
abstract_zh: 病毒复制抑制剂（IVR）是一种可诱导蛋白，不具有病毒靶标特异性，可由多种病毒诱导产生。通过检索GenBank数据库，寻找与烟草IVR密切相关的序列。来自烟草、番茄和马铃薯的各种RNA片段及其基因组DNA中含有IVR样序列。然而，IVR是这些基因组DNA序列所编码的更大蛋白质的一部分，这些蛋白质在拟南芥中被鉴定为与称为后期促进复合物7（APC7）的周期体蛋白相关。对九个植物物种的推定APC7进行序列分析显示，这些蛋白质由558-561个氨基酸组成，序列高度保守，包含至少六个由34个氨基酸组成的蛋白质结合元件，称为四肽重复序列（TPRs），其形成螺旋-转角-螺旋结构。使用AlphaFold程序对拟南芥APC7和烟草IVR蛋白的结构进行建模并叠加，结果显示IVR具有与APC7 C端34%相同的结构，表明IVR是APC7基因的产物。基于APC7序列中IVR编码序列上游存在多种转录因子结合位点，我们提出IVR可能由这些APC7基因序列表达，并涉及转录因子SHE1。
